name: NemsisOriginalCode
title: Original NEMSIS NV/PN Code Retained on a Primitive
description:
Retains the source NEMSIS Not-Value (NV, 7701xxx) or Pertinent-Negative (PN, 8801xxx) coding on a FHIR PRIMITIVE element, alongside either a data-absent-reason or a value carried at reduced precision.

Coded NEMSIS elements dual-code natively — the standard coding and the original NEMSIS coding sit together in one CodeableConcept (ADR-003). Primitives cannot: `Patient.gender`, `Observation.effectiveDateTime` and friends hold a single value, so `data-absent-reason` alone can say THAT a value is missing but loses the source's own reason for it. NEMSIS distinguishes 'Not Applicable' from 'Not Recorded' from 'Not Reporting', and 'Refused' from 'Unable to Complete' — distinctions that carry clinical and audit meaning and must not be flattened (the NV/PN-are-first-class hard rule).

Two uses:

1. Beside a `data-absent-reason` extension, where no value is derivable — the FHIR code says what any consumer needs, this says what the source actually recorded.
2. Beside a PRESENT value carried at reduced precision — e.g. a vital with no `eVitals.01` expressed at the encounter's date precision. Here there is a value, so data-absent-reason would be wrong; this extension explains why the precision is reduced.

Proposed upstream to IHE PCC alongside the mPSC NEMSIS mapping.

element.short: Original NEMSIS NV/PN coding for this primitive
The NEMSIS NV (7701xxx) or PN (8801xxx) code as recorded
